review_status: Author proof and deterministic certificate checks; not an independent project Review.
cover_definition: Finite prime divisibility cover; properness is separate.

theorems.finite_character: tau = sup_L tau_L, including infinity; proof.md Theorem 2.
theorems.gcd_partition: Finite sample tau equals least number of blocks with common gcd > 1; proof.md Theorem 3.
theorems.fixed_budget_bound: U_0=1; U_(j+1)=U_j*(k*2^U_j-1); tau(k)<=t iff tau_(U_t)(k)<=t; proof.md Theorem 4.
theorems.minimal_cover_product_bound: Only inclusion-minimal size-s full covers satisfy product(Q)<=U_s.
theorems.profinite_scope: No finite cover iff a compatible formal exponent avoids every odd prime; existence for the fixed old square root remains unproved.

general_nu_1_tau_3_example.scope: General integer-sequence example; not claimed to be an exponential Riesel orbit.

native_BRC_check.pin_provenance: research_notes/portable_direct/riesel_mixed_20261119/results.json; same four pins in v4 phase verification.
native_BRC_check.carrier_scope: Fixed X6 anchor; internal integer register; exponent is not physical time or an added space axis.
native_BRC_check.BRC_scope: Exactly one output; positive weight 1 and multiplicity 1, checked each call.
native_BRC_check.observation_identity: O_Q(T(x)) = T_Q(O_Q(x)), checked on every native step and every prime channel.

limitations: Finite examples do not replace the universal proofs.
Fixed-budget decidability does not settle unbounded existence of any finite cover.
No non-cover theorem for the fixed old square root is claimed.
Profinite formal exponents and formal roots are auxiliary observation completions, not actual integer BRC states.
